name: AST Modular / DMS International Private Cloud Box at Caracol Industrial Park
notes: DCD reported AST Modular deployed a modular cloud data center for DMS International at the 600-acre Caracol Industrial Park; DCK also reported successful delivery of AST's Private Cloud Box, with 85 virtual machines in a 42U micro data center footprint.

name: Caracol Industrial Park disaster recovery data center
notes: Data Center Knowledge stated that Caracol Industrial Park was home to a state-of-the-art disaster recovery data center. Details on owner, MW capacity, and whether it is separate from the AST/DMS modular deployment were not published in the source.

name: Maison Henri Deschamps / RETEL Tier III data center
developer: Maison Henri Deschamps / RETEL; Cisco; United Data Technologies
notes: Cisco announced that Maison Henri Deschamps would build a state-of-the-art Tier III data center in Port-au-Prince, offering colocation, business continuity, disaster recovery, and IaaS services. Later operational confirmation was not found in this pass.

name: Digicel Haiti main data center at headquarters
notes: North America Outlook reported Digicel Haiti solarized its headquarters, which houses its main data center. Digicel's official contact page places the Haiti office at #151 Angle Ave Jean Paul II & Impasse Duverger, Port-au-Prince.
